content: Ẹmmaana cha Isaak
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi odo Sara, mach'iwa okk'ochekhi.
Sara okwu otzima ibhọr, ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng ọnang Abraham k'atzam. Wa nnwa nwa ọmaan otzor k'ogbe kw'iwa Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ochekhi bi ọmaana.
Mẹ wọ, Abraham okpe nnwa nwa kwa Sara ọmaani, Isaak.
Okwu opyiri iwu izenanttaan sa nnwa nwa kwẹ Isaak ọmaan, Abraham ọsẹ-ẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ otzor k'odem kw'Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹ ọtzọhna.
Wa Abraham ode cho arọbh azen, k'ogbe kwa nnwa kwẹ Isaak, ọmaan.
Mẹ wọ, Sara oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ọsa bi mma aha. Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọbhaang odik nwa kw'Ibinọkpaabyi osi ọnang-m, obiro otzor-m ọmma aha.”
Ochina ororo oben bi, “Anyi wọ ira ọgbaak Abraham bi, na kaam Sara mfha nnọk nnwa? Yina, kaam nkk'nnwa kw'ijinọng mmaana nnang Abraham k'atzam pẹ.”
Nnwa nwa ọbar, ọkka otzim-ẹ ẹba, okwu opyiri k'ewu ch'ọkka otzimi Isaak ẹba, Abraham osi ọdadaami kw'ideden.
Abraham okhubhi Hagar ọmaana Ishimayẹl
Wa Sara ore da nnwa nwa kwa Hagar kw'ofon Ijip ọmaani ọnang Abraham, om-osi ẹyaanga-tzama ttara Isaak.
Mẹ wọ, Sara oben Abraham bi, “Khubh obira-kwanọng nwa ttara nnwa kwẹ, bẹ arọhng afona. Nnwa nwa kw'obira-kwanọng kọbaan bi ọkhaama ekkema k'ojibhada kwọ, kwa nnwa kwaam Isaak ọ́tzọkha.”
Wa odik nwa ọyakhi Abraham atzim k'ettem kpọng-kpọng, da ore bi, Ishimayẹl obiro ode nnwa kwẹ.

Yina, Ibinọkpaabyi oben Abraham bi, “Ettem ening-ọ atzim ẹyakhi okhuri nnwa nwa ọmaana obira-kwanọng kwọ. Si odik kpenamkpen kwa Sara oben-ọ bi, asi, okhuri bi, orenga ma Isaak va pa va pọ, áhaabh-ọhaabh atzor k'echekhi ch'iwa nkk'nnanga.
Kaam ńsi nnwa kw'obira-kwanọng nwa obiro ọkhaama ẹkhọma chẹ, okhuri da kẹ obiro ode nnwa kwọ.”

Mẹ wọ e, Abraham obina k'ekpekpebha ọtzọkha ọchattọhk, obiro ọtzọkha asi, okhe k'ẹkpa ch'ede etzenkpa, ọnang Hagar. Abraham ọtzọkha pyẹ ọnan-ẹ ka mbabaang, okhubh-ẹ ọmaana nnwa kwẹ. Mẹ wọ, Hagar obina ochina k'ebherede, k'okhubha kwa Bẹrshẹba.
Mada asi mba p'awobh k'ẹkpa ch'ede etzenkpa akk'an-aha, Hagar ọtzọkha nnwa oruri k'ochi-gbagba wani.
Ọn-ọpaangi owobha ẹwọr k'oden-mir, oben for sẹ bi, “Kaam ettem kingaama nwobha ma nne nnwa kwaam ope.” Mada otzim owobh ẹwọr mẹ, nnwa kwẹ osẹ-ẹ nkwo, on-obhom ẹmọng k'ẹrọng.

Wa Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga ẹmọng cha nnwa nwa obhomi. Orenga-eden kw'Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ẹrọng oben Hagar bi, “Bọng odik wọ o? Oning-ọ ojor, mada nnwa kwọ oyim mẹ, Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ẹmọng chẹ ch'obhomi, ọbhaanga.
Bina atza atzini nnwa kwọ, kkeri kaam ńsẹ-ẹ ode otte kw'ẹkhọma ch'ideden.”
Mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi osi Hagar ore esipe. Otzima ẹkpa ch'ede etzenkpa, ọtza ọkhaabha asi maa chẹ efhu, ọnang nnwa ogwo.
Wa Ibinọkpaabyi owobha ttara nnwa nwa mada ọm-ọbar. Wa nnwa nwa oruk k'ebherede, ode ọgbajijaa kw'ideden.
Mada iwa nnwa nwa orukhi k'ebherede ka Paran, ọkka kwẹ ọtza ọtzọkha ominanwa kw'ofon Ijip, ọnang-ẹ k'ọbada.
Abraham ọmaana Abimẹlẹk asi echekhi
K'ogbe nwuma, Abimẹlẹk otzim Phikol kw'ode oho kw'agbongnọng pẹ, ọtza oben Abraham bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttara kọ k'odik kpenamkpen kw'asi.

Mẹ wọ, kọ chekhi anang-m m'itzitzikha s'Ibinọkpaabyi bi, kaam kàbọhra ọmaana va paam, ttara va pa va paam. Kọ si ẹmmaana ọkkakka atzima atzor-m, ọmaana ẹkhọma nda cha kọ arukhi mach'okhekhen-nọng, atzor macha kaam nsi nnang-ọ.”
Abraham oben bi, “Kaam nkk'nchekhi.”
Mẹ wọ e, Abraham ọgbaak Abimẹlẹk odik okhuri esipe chẹ, ch'atzọhmnọng pa kẹ Abimẹlẹk akk'ẹ abọhkha ana.
Yina, Abimẹlẹk obhin-ẹ bi, “Kaam ọnọng kw'osi odik nwa kinnong, kọ kaam odik-dema nwa atzima am-agbaakha, mayina wọ kwa kaam nna mmaang kwẹ.”
Mẹ wọ, Abraham ọtzọkha arukhimaan ọmaana abhaam, ọnang Abimẹlẹk, bẹ anọng mba afa asi echekhi anang ayok.
Abraham ọtzọkha arukhimaan-papẹ azenamfa k'etzirakpo pyẹ, ọkhọm ohok.
Abimẹlẹk ọn-ọbọbh Abraham bi, “Arukhimaan-papẹ mba azenamfa p'akhọmi ahok ka, ayini yan o?”
Abraham obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ khera bi, atzọkha arukhimaan-papẹ mba azenamfa pa kaam nnang-ọ, mando wọ ọkhọkha bi, kọ akk'akhera bi, kaam wọ ndumi esipe nda.”
Mẹ wọ, anọng ayeri ibe nna Bẹrshẹba, okhuri bi, mẹ wọ kw'ajinọng mba afa awobh asi echekhi anang ayok.
Mada bẹ akk'echekhi nda asa ka Beershẹba, Abimẹlẹk otzima Phikol nwa kw'ode oho kw'arim-egbong pẹ, ọkpa nnam abhana k'ẹkhọma cha Philistiya.
Wa Abraham ogboni echi cha tamaris ka Bẹrshẹba. M'ibe nna rọ sa kẹ, om-owobha okpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ipemanitzor.
Wa Abraham oruk m'ẹkhọma nda cha Philistiya k'ogbe-bhirada.
